text.tspan: Snake, I found someone who can help us.
Another scientist? I don't need dead weight, Otacon.
He's different. They call him 'Dr. Astrobleto'...
Astrobleto? What kind of codename is that?
It's a blend of Latin roots and military slang! 'Impact crater',
or 'The Star Scar'—he leaves a scar of extraordinary code on every project.
He built the enemy's database structure, so only he can bypass it.
He architected their PHP and Laravel backend,
and now he's controlling the React interface.
Plus, he's mastering WebGL protocols. He can render real-time
data flows directly onto your Soliton Radar for a massive tactical edge.
If he built their system, he knows every blind spot.
I want his contact info and all data you have on this 'Astroblem'.
Got it, Snake! Leave it to me! Encrypting the feed and opening
a secure line on frequency 141.15. R-right, Snake... be careful out there!
